workflow: A runtime enables execution tracing for a worker and allocates auxiliary tracing storage.
The worker finishes or the runtime begins shutdown without releasing that storage.
The allocation remains reachable only to leak detection after the tracing operation has completed.
Leak detection reports the unreclaimed storage as a memory leak instead of clean teardown.
summary: Tracing initialization leaks auxiliary storage across worker completion or shutdown
decision_reason: The underlying failure is materially the same as a successful operation omitting cleanup of temporary owned state: tracing setup allocates auxiliary heap storage, but the normal completion or shutdown path fails to reclaim it. The worker/thread and tracing details are symptoms and implementation, so
